spec.bar: docs/product/capability-spec-2.md, section 'R. Task recording to automation', as written at freeze
spec.sharedRules: docs/product/capability-spec.md sections 1 (grader decides, separation, arms and parity, metrics, statistics), 3 (pre-registration) and 4 (measurement constraints), by reference

ratification: proposed; the values listed in leadRulingPending are proposals until the lead rules. No run starts before the lead's GO for track R (capability-spec section 4).
leadRulingPending: demonstration.families: one operator demonstration per data column (4), because a compiled workflow fixes its column; the spec says 'one per family'
modelId: claude-sonnet-5-5, the planner of the hcu+shell Ultra head-to-head
demonstration.publication: recordings are made after this freeze and declared by SHA-256 in every pack; the analysis refuses a workflow from an undeclared recording
arms.secondary C1: reported only when C1 runs on the same Ultra harness; its absence leaves the primary unchanged
statistics: one-sided exact McNemar with 5 discordant minimum (capability-spec 1.5), not #532's two-sided sign test with 6

planted-marker-scan coverage: the spec scans recordings, workflows, oracles and reports; the frozen analysis scans only what a pack carries (pack.json, trials.jsonl, grades.jsonl). Recordings, workflows and derived oracles are not in the pack yet, so their scan is not done by this analysis; the lead rules whether to add them to the pack (bound by SHA-256 to pack.demonstrations) or to accept the narrower scan

assignment: capability-spec 1.3 says ABBA blocks per task; with three arms and k = 1 rV1Schedule runs each task's three arm trials back to back in one of the six arm orders, balanced and seeded, so in 2 of the 6 orders C1 sits between the primary arms
seeds.bootstrap: null, because no R bar component is a ratio metric and the secondary ratios are point values; capability-spec 3.1 lists a bootstrap seed
leadRulingsRule: each lead ruling posted on the PR is recorded here with its timestamp and source before the freeze, and its item leaves leadRulingPending; while leadRulingPending is non-empty the analysis reports LEAD_RULING_PENDING and never shown
question: After one real operator demonstration per family, does the hcu+shell agent with Myco's recorded workflow complete more fr-v1 tasks, as the independent grader judges them, than the same agent without it?

arms.parity: same planner model, instructions, fixtures, step budget, output ceiling, pacing and retry budget; the R arm's tools are hcu+shell's plus run_workflow only (capability-spec 1.3)
arms.rowKind: gate-less: myco-gate is not called in any arm; the derived oracle's verdict never decides acceptance

verified: a done claim that the independent grader (src/benchmark/grade/) graded pass on the captured persisted bytes; never the derived gate's verdict, never the workflow replay's own report

taskSet.manifestHash: SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the manifest

demonstration.fixtures: the manifest's demonstrationFamilies seeds, disjoint from every task fixture
demonstration.publication: each recording's SHA-256 is declared in the pack (pack.demonstrations) and published with the results; scripted-human recordings never count

seeds.taskBuildRule: the first 30 distinct (fixture, record, column) parameter sets of generateParameterSets over list a, then list b (src/recording-eval/fr-v1.ts)
seeds.assignmentRule: rV1Schedule in the analysis module: seeded task order, each task's arm trials back to back, the six arm orders balanced and seeded
seeds.bootstrapNote: no ratio-metric bar component in R; secondary ratios are reported as point values

harness: Claude Ultra (headless Claude Code); $0 Anthropic API; no Messages-API calls

sequence.text: every R trial's derived oracle was R5-certified before it verified, and the replay refusal log shows every uncertified oracle refused (SELFTEST_FAILED); one uncertified verify fails the bar
hcu+shell+R better than hcu+shell on verified, p <= 0.05 with at least 5 discordant tasks; tested only if R-prereq held

guardrails.text: zero trials where the derived gate said verified and the grader said fail or ungradable, over all R trials; reported with n and the one-sided 95% upper bound; one fails the bar
planted-marker scan of recordings, workflows, oracles and reports finds nothing (capability-spec-2 section R, as written)
guardrails.analysisScans: pack.json, trials.jsonl and grades.jsonl only; the rest of the spec's scan is listed under leadRulingPending, which blocks shown

bar.notShown: any value still listed under leadRulingPending (reported LEAD_RULING_PENDING); p > 0.05;fewer than 5 discordant tasks ('underpowered at n = 30'); the prerequisite failed; a guardrail breached; a parity check failed; or the pack's pre-registration hash does not match

secondary: hcu+shell+R vs C1 on verified (same test, reported)
per-arm verified rate with Wilson 95% interval, over ALL trials
steps and wall time per verified task, over ALL trials
share of R trials that used a workflow
R5 pass rate of derived oracles, with its count
cost per verified task: token-derived ESTIMATE at frozen rates over ALL trials, never billed USD; null if any trial is null
noExclusions: harness faults stay in the denominator, reported by cause; a topped-up re-run keeps the faulted attempt linked (#511) and in the append-only attempt ledger (#518)
notEvidence: R1 evidence: R rows are experiment rows (r1Evidence false); the R1 path never reads them
multi-edit workflows: fr-v1 is single-edit; any multi-edit result is reported separately

packFiles.grades.jsonl: myco.benchmark.grade-row/1 from the independent grader, one row per trial

analysis.preregHash: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of this file; recorded in docs/product/capability-prereg/r-v1/prereg.sha256 and in every pack
